items.title: Review Process
items.description: Your appeal will be reviewed by our administrative team within 5-7 business days.

items.title: Email Notification
items.description: You will receive an email notification once a decision has been made on your appeal.

items.title: Track Your Appeal
items.description: You can check the status of your appeal anytime through the Violator Portal using your reference number.

items.title: Payment Hold
items.description: Your payment deadline is automatically extended while your appeal is under review.

content.text: Please save your appeal reference number for future correspondence. If your appeal is denied, you will need to pay the full ticket amount within 10 days of the decision date to avoid additional penalties.
